PART III - LANDS NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO LAND PARCELS Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998 (Section 12) NOTICE No.: 27/0023 Batticaloa District IT is hereby notified that any person having a claim to the ownership or possession or interest to one or more of the parcels of land reflected in the Cadastral Map No. 270204 made by the Surveyor-General under Section 11 of the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998 relating to the village of Iluppadichenai (Block 10) or any part thereof, situated within the Grama Niladhari Division of No.148 - Iluppadichenai in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Manmunai West in the District of Batticaloa in the Province of Eastern should submit his claim to the undersigned before 27th of March 2025 In the event of failure to submit any claim before the above-mentioned date, action will be taken to hold an ex parte inquiry to determine title to the land and accordingly publish such determination in the Government Gazette in terms of Section 14 of the above Act. The Cadastral Map No. 270204 referred to above may be perused at the relevant Grama Niladhari Office, Divisional Secretary’s, District Survey Office, Office of the Commissioner of Title Settlement, or the Surveyor - General’s office. Further information may be obtained from the Grama Niladhari, the Divisional Secretary, or the Commissioner of Title Settlement. P.C. D. SIGERA, Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement... Land Title Settlement Department, No.1200/6, “Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla 27th of February 2025, EOG 03-0244/1
